examples.title: Set a geometry export path
examples.code:
# Export an incoming geometry/scene stream.
write_geo = nuke.createNode("WriteGeo")
write_geo.setInput(0, scene)
write_geo["file"].setValue("D:/exports/scene.abc")

examples.title: Limit the geometry export frame range
examples.code:
# Restrict an animated geometry export to a frame range.
write_geo = nuke.createNode("WriteGeo")
write_geo["first"].setValue(1001)
write_geo["last"].setValue(1100)

# Configure the "file_type" control.
writeGeo = nuke.createNode("WriteGeo")
writeGeo["file_type"].setValue("abc")
